profile.summary: Kids in Need of Defense (KIND) is a nonprofit based in Washington, DC that provides legal services and advocacy for children. It also gives technical assistance to programs that support immigrant youth, such as California's Opportunities for Youth project.

sources.title: Opportunities for Youth - California Department of Social Services

review.notes: ProPublica confirms the Washington, DC 501(c)(3) Kind Inc (Kids In Need Of Defense), EIN 26-2763038, in the legal services category. The CDSS page names KIND as technical assistance provider and Oakland Unified as a service provider, which fits the unaccompanied immigrant youth grant. The summary is neutral and supported.
